title: The Crown Unwound
plays: After castle4 (The Null Crown): the game is won. Then the credits.
synopsis: On the Postnikov Spire every place Null took is proved on the Chart, and the Crown has nothing left to fold: it cracks and shatters. Null, unmasked by grief, tells them who he lost. Gyroid gives him a ring to keep; the Commutator lays down his blade; Emmy chooses to finish what she and Null started. The Crown's shards catch fire and fly to every folded point, and the world blooms back: Retract Reef's walkways and the Ringed Isle, Haven Ring, Bouquet Bastion, the Delta's sphere, the torus and its twin, the Cup Product Gardens, and the Spire relit. At dawn on Haven's quay Gyroid makes his last delivery: Emmy's Chart. Null, alone at sunrise, looks through the ring's hole. Fireworks; title.

scenes.title: Proved
scenes.description: The Spire's summit at night. Gyroid faces Null: everything is on the Chart.

scenes.title: The Crown breaks
scenes.description: The Crown flares, cracks, and shatters; its pieces fall, six bright shards rise and hang in the sky.

scenes.title: Who he lost
scenes.description: Null, bowed, tells them who wound away. Emmy, Gyroid's gift of a ring, the Commutator, Emmy's resolve.

scenes.title: The law runs backwards
scenes.description: Behind the summit: the shards catch fire and streak out over the dark sea to the white points where places were.

scenes.title: The world unfolds
scenes.description: Each place blooms back from its point: Retract Reef and the Ringed Isle, Haven Ring, Bouquet Bastion, the Delta's sphere, the torus and its twin, the Gardens; the Spire relights gold; dawn.

scenes.title: One delivery
scenes.description: Dawn on Haven's quay. Gyroid runs in with the Chart and delivers it to Emmy. Bend it, don't break it, and prove it.

scenes.title: A road home
scenes.description: Null alone on the summit at sunrise, holding the ring up to the light.

scenes.title: Winding World
scenes.description: Fireworks over Haven; the camera rises over the whole restored world; title card.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: It’s proved, Null. Every place you took is on the Chart. Your Crown has nothing left to fold.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: She took the long road round, one evening. It wound away… and she never came home.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: So I made a world with nowhere to fall. A point has nowhere to fall, Emmy.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: We built those presses so no courier would ever get lost. Not so that no one could ever leave.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: A point has nowhere to go, either. Here. Keep this. Look at its hole for a while.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: I kept your order for years, Count. It was never order. It was erasing.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Then let’s finish what we started. Properly, this time.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Tonight, on the Spire, the Crown had folded the whole Way at once. Now its law ran backwards: every place on the Chart came home.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Haven! Every lamp’s lit. They’re home.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Every shape a little different. Every hole exactly where it had been.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: My Chart. Every place on it, proved.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: Delivered, signed, and in order. Well run, courier.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: It has a hole. Somebody’s road home.
